_comment: The agent registry. Each entry is one AG-UI endpoint OpenBot can register,
and one name a case file can be addressed to with `assignee:`.
command   : the program that runs the agent. It reads the prompt on stdin
(prompt_mode: stdin), as one argument (prompt_mode: arg), or
with {prompt} substituted into an argument (prompt_mode: argv).
cwd       : where it runs. Point this at the agent-library checkout.
timeout   : seconds before the run is abandoned.
chain     : the routing order. The default answers first; if it fails,
the next one takes over. The AG-UI reply carries the name of
the agent that actually answered, and the handoff audit log
records it too.
The three real agents below are the ones this box already has, with the
commands the agent-library receipts prove work:
qoder    qoder -p            Qoder CLI, headless, no session persisted
glm      claude -p            Claude Code on zai/glm-5.3
minimax  codex exec -m        Codex on minimax-io/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash
Evidence: agent-library catalogs/skills/canonical/qoder-bridge/SKILL.md:57
and sessions/labs/staging/WI-006-smart-ai-router-angr8/Cases/
angr8-003-lang-gate-router/ops/VERIFICATION.md:100 (claude -p) and
.../receipts/2026-11-07-upgrade-v250.md:32 (codex exec).
The installer detects which of these binaries are on the PATH and only
keeps the entries it can run.  An entry with an empty command is listed
but not runnable.

agents.name: qoder
agents.description: Primary engineer agent — the Qoder CLI in headless mode. Note: -p can exit 0 on an error, so the reply is read as text and the exit code alone is not proof of success.

agents.name: glm
agents.description: Z.ai GLM — second opinion, long-context review. Claude Code CLI on zai/glm-5.3 through the local router.

agents.name: minimax
agents.description: MiniMax — throughput agent. Codex CLI on minimax-io/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash through the local router.

agents.name: echo
agents.description: Built-in example. Echoes the prompt back, so the bridge can be proved working before a real agent is wired up.
